summary_1line: Arjuna dazzles the arena with weapon feats until Karna enters, matches them, and challenges him, igniting rivalry while Kunti secretly recognizes her firstborn.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna, gleaming with natural armor and earrings, strides into the arena like a walking cliff as the crowd parts in astonishment.
Arjuna and Karna stand ready with drawn bows while dark clouds gather over Arjuna and sunlight breaks over Karna.
Duryodhana joyfully embraces Karna in the arena before the assembled princes and spectators.
